title: tristellateia madagascariensis var. heterophylla

It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The Madagascar tristellateia has been reported to possess health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in reducing fever, alleviating pain, and promoting wound healing.
